title: Lions defeat Stampeders in Canadian Football League match
summary: The BC Lions defeated the Calgary Stampeders with a score of 30-26. This victory marks the Lions' third consecutive win. The match was part of the Canadian Football League season.
summary_points: BC Lions secured a 30-26 victory over the Calgary Stampeders.
This win is the third in a row for the BC Lions.
The game was part of the Canadian Football League season.
